crossRefs.note: “ ‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.
Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that…
“ ‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and…

translations.web: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.
translations.bsb: Do not defile yourselves by any crawling creature; do not become unclean or defiled by them.
translations.kjv: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled
translations.asv: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
